headline: Public exploit code and a working proof-of-concept now chase the wp2shell flaws in WordPress core, letting a single anonymous request run code on any unpatched 6.9 or 7.0 site.

emerging_trends.text: The gap between a patch and mass exploitation keeps shrinking, and wp2shell shows it—public exploit code and a working proof-of-concept began chasing unpatched WordPress sites within days of the fix.

topics.title: Hikvision Camera API Draws Internet-Wide Scans
topics.latest_developments: The SANS Internet Storm Center reported July 19, 2026 that its honeypot network is picking up internet-wide scans probing the Hikvision Intelligent Security API.
topics.summary: Hikvision, the Chinese maker of internet-connected security cameras, carries a long history of vulnerabilities that draw mass scanning. The current scans hunt exposed Intelligent Security API endpoints, so operators should pull these cameras off the public internet and update firmware.

sources.title: Scans for Hikvision Intelligent Security API, (Sun, Jul 19th)

topics.title: wp2shell WordPress Core RCE Gets Public Exploits
topics.latest_developments: Attackers now hold public exploits and a working proof-of-concept for the two wp2shell bugs, which carry CVE IDs CVE-2026-60137 and CVE-2026-63030, and researchers surfaced a persistent-object-cache variant that widens the reach.
topics.summary: wp2shell pairs two WordPress core flaws—a facilitated SQL injection and a REST API batch-route confusion that chains to remote code execution—so a single anonymous HTTP request runs code on a bare install with zero plugins. Adam Kues of Assetnote and Searchlight Cyber, along with the trio TF1T, dtro, and haongo, reported the bugs; WordPress fixed them in 6.9.5 and 7.0.2, so administrators of every 6.9 and 7.0 site must patch now.

sources.title: WordPress Core "wp2shell" RCE flaws get public exploits, patch now
Two new high severity WordPress vulnerabilities, patch immediately!
New wp2shell WordPress Core Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code

topics.title: ACR Stealer Surge Hits Microsoft Customers
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft warned its enterprise customers on July 18, 2026 of a fresh surge in ACR Stealer infections that lift browser-stored passwords, authentication tokens, and sensitive documents.
topics.summary: ACR Stealer is an information stealer that operators spread largely through ClickFix lures, which trick users into pasting a malicious command. It targets Microsoft's enterprise customers, so defenders should block clipboard-run PowerShell and reset harvested credentials and tokens.

sources.title: Microsoft warns of surge in ACR Stealer attacks on customers

business_politics.title: U.S.-Iran War Widens Toward Israel
business_politics.latest_developments: A third U.S. service member died Saturday, July 18, in Iraq during a controlled detonation of an Iranian drone, and Iran fired missiles toward Jordan that Israel warned are landing close to its own territory, threatening to pull Israel into the fight.
business_politics.summary: Iranian ballistic missiles killed two U.S. troops and left one missing in Jordan, prompting U.S. Central Command to launch fresh strikes to "swiftly punish" Tehran; Iran had used a brief earlier truce to rush out about $6 billion of oil on roughly 20 tankers bound for Asia before Washington reimposed pressure, keeping crude and the Strait of Hormuz at the center of market risk.

business.title: Panasonic Toaster Ovens Recalled
business.latest_developments: Panasonic recalled 11,480 electric toaster ovens nationwide, telling owners to stop using them and check the model number.
business.summary: The recall covers Panasonic electric toaster ovens sold online through Amazon and Costco for about $170, which the company says pose a shock or fire hazard.

around_town.title: Two Tornadoes Confirmed After Saturday Storms
around_town.latest_developments: The National Weather Service confirmed Sunday, July 19, that two tornadoes touched down in Pennsylvania during Saturday's storms, one of them in Western Pennsylvania, and it is examining a possible third in Derry Township, Westmoreland County.
around_town.summary: Severe storms swept Western Pennsylvania on Saturday, July 18, downing trees and flooding roads across Westmoreland and Jefferson counties, damage crews are still clearing.
